```{=html}
<div class="metric-grid">
<div class="metric"><strong>37%</strong><span>UP5K logic utilization</span><small>1971 / 5280 logic cells</small><div class="resource-meter" aria-hidden="true"><span style="width:37.33%"></span></div></div>

<div class="metric"><strong>45.79</strong><span>MHz · routed maximum clock estimate</span><small>24 MHz nominal requirement</small></div>
</div>
<p class="evidence-caption">Recorded with YoWASP Yosys 0.70 and nextpnr-ice40 0.11.1 for the enabled top-level design. These are tool estimates, not measured board performance.</p>
```

The verification build overrides `top.COMMISSIONED=1` for a meaningful active-design resource check. Source defaults remain disabled. The default disabled top-level was also built and routed separately.

## Recorded checks

The following summarizes the existing [verification record](docs/verification.qmd). These engineering checks were recorded on October 15; they are distinct from checks performed on this website.

| Check | Recorded result | What it establishes |
|---|---|---|
| Native C compilation | Passed; warnings treated as errors | Host compilation using Zig / Clang |
| C behavior tests | Passed | CRC, packet layout, controller direction, saturation, ramps, faults, web route and buffer handling |
| Cortex-M4F compilation | Seven translation units compiled | Source compatibility with the checked headers and runtime |
| HDL elaboration | Checked with slang and Icarus | SystemVerilog elaboration |
| FPGA integration simulation | Passed | ADC command sequencing, telemetry, regulation, timeout and fault behavior, disabled defaults |
| Calibration tests | Three tests passed | Identifiable-model recovery, degenerate-signal rejection, nonlinear-fit residuals |
| FPGA synthesis and routing | 24 MHz requirement passed | Internal synchronous timing estimate for the checked implementation |

## What has not been measured

| Physical outcome | Status | Evidence needed |
|---|---|---|
| Levitation duration | Not measured | Continuous supported-to-free suspension trial |
| Gap accuracy and repeatability | Not measured | Independent reference position measurements |
| Settling and disturbance rejection | Not measured | Recorded step and disturbance responses |
| Hall observability during current changes | Not measured | Fixed-object current sweeps and transient tests |
| External timing and shutdown delay | Not measured | Scope captures of buses, PWM, and interlock |
| Coil and power-stage temperature | Not measured | Logged thermal run at the intended operating point |

The full GNU Arm executable/runtime link and board-programming workflow also remain unverified. Simulation uses ideal ADC inputs and a fixed clock, not a validated physical coil model.

## The next experiment

The first decisive result is whether the sensor arrangement distinguishes object position from coil-current changes. A static numerical fit is insufficient. Hold the object at known gaps, sweep current, reserve independent holdout data, and test transient compensation before closing the position loop.

[Follow the calibration procedure →](docs/calibration.qmd)
